blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
British customer service is polite, quiet and steady. The goal is not to be loud or too friendly. The goal is to solve the problem with a smile and the smallest possible fuss.

You will hear "Thank you for your patience", "I'm terribly sorry about that", and "Let's see what we can do." These phrases are normal. "I'm terribly sorry" does not mean panic. It is just a polite way to speak.

Complaints are welcomed in a calm way. The British believe that a complaint handled well makes a loyal customer. It may feel slow. But there is real discipline under the politeness.

items.q: What is the goal of British customer service?
options: To solve the problem with a smile and small fuss
To make the customer wait a long time
To be loud and very friendly
items.why: "solve the problem with a smile and the smallest possible fuss."

items.q: How are complaints treated?
options: They are sent to another office
They are welcomed in a calm way
items.why: "Complaints are welcomed in a calm way."

items.q: The phrase "I'm terribly sorry" suggests that the worker is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que a frase "does not mean panic" — é só educação.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with the idea that…
options: loud and pushy service is the best way
British service is quiet and steady
a good complaint can make a loyal customer
items.why: Inferência: o texto defende o estilo calmo e educado, não o barulhento.

items.q: "There is real discipline under the politeness" suggests that the service is…
options: slow because the workers are lazy
items.why: Inferência: sob a educação há método e organização, não preguiça.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry treinando o novo atendente. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team. Today I will show you how we help an upset customer. It is easier than you think, and it works well here at Czarnikow.

First, listen. The customer just wants to be heard. Do not talk too much. Let them speak. When they finish, say "Thank you for your patience." This is very important. It shows respect.

Next, stay calm and polite. If there is a problem, say "I'm terribly sorry about that." Then say "Let's see what we can do." These small phrases work like magic. They are quiet, but they are strong.

Please take a seat with the customer if you can. Do offer a cup of tea. A calm customer is a happy customer. Speak slowly and keep your voice steady. Remember, we solve the problem with the smallest possible fuss.

A good complaint is not a bad thing. When we handle it well, that person becomes a loyal customer. So smile, stay steady, and never panic. Take your time, and you will be great.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Harry say the new worker must do FIRST?
options: Listen and let the customer speak
items.why: "First, listen. The customer just wants to be heard."

items.q: What phrase should the worker say when the customer finishes?
items.why: "When they finish, say 'Thank you for your patience.'"

items.q: What does Harry offer to the customer?
options: A cup of tea and a seat
items.why: "Please take a seat… Do offer a cup of tea."

items.q: When Harry says the small phrases "work like magic", he means they…
options: help calm the customer even though they are simple
should be used only once a day
items.why: Inferência: frases simples e calmas têm grande efeito no cliente.

items.q: How does Harry feel about complaints?
options: He thinks they can lead to a loyal customer
He thinks they are always bad
items.why: Inferência: "A good complaint is not a bad thing… that person becomes a loyal customer."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "She works in customer service and helps people every day." Customer service is…
items.why: Customer service = atendimento ao cliente.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Thank you for your ___ while we fix the problem."
items.why: Patience = paciência; frase padrão de atendimento.

items.q: "A loyal customer comes back again and again." A loyal customer is one who…
options: stays and keeps buying from you
items.why: Loyal customer = cliente fiel, que continua voltando.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "He made a ___ because his order was wrong."
items.why: Complaint = reclamação.

items.q: "Please stay calm and speak slowly." Calm means…
items.why: Calm = calmo, tranquilo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no atendimento ao cliente. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's see what we can do." This means the worker will…
options: try to help and find a solution
items.why: É o clássico abridor britânico: vou tentar resolver.

items.q: "Please take a seat and I will help you." To take a seat means to…
items.why: Take a seat = sentar-se.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the refund." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente.

items.q: "We must follow up on every complaint." To follow up on means to…
options: send it to the wrong desk
check back and make sure it is done
items.why: Follow up on = dar continuidade, acompanhar até resolver.

items.q: "Do calm down the customer before you speak." To calm someone down means to…
items.why: Calm down = acalmar, deixar mais tranquilo.
